verifier.root_cause_release: Pinned vendor trust anchor remains in split-immediate instructions; literal 32-byte replacement misses these sites. Custom-signed input cannot verify against that anchor. Applies to audited artifact, not all historical releases.

lab_boot_fault_localization.causal_claim: The abort is observed in the modified-image run and not in the successful identical-NPK rewrite control. The check input dataflow and cause of the mismatch remain unresolved; no specific patched anchor, anti-tamper or upgrade semantics are established. The NPK also differs in packing and signature, not just decoded program bytes.

logic_errors.finding: Raw C7 scanning does not establish instruction boundaries; operand-size prefix can cause unrelated bytes to be rewritten and counted.
Executable section ranges can overlap ELF metadata; header size/version not fully validated.
Sibling fixture imports fail when invoking integration tests as a package module.
